caption:
The video captures a serene mountain-lake landscape viewed from a wooden dock, with fixed framing. In the foreground lie weathered dock planks, a rustic wooden bench, and orange-tinged shrubbery. A small evergreen stands near the water's edge on the left. Across the lake stretches a forested shoreline of conifers, backed by a snow-streaked peak and a sunlit green ridge under a partly cloudy sky. A teal lens-flare disc rests over the left slope.

The most evident motion is the gentle, continuous ripple across the lake surface, where the pattern of light and dark wave lines shifts gradually from frame to frame and briefly disturbs the reflected treeline near the shore. The dock, bench, foreground shrub, evergreen trees, shoreline, mountains, and lens-flare disc appear fixed. The camera seems stationary throughout, with no object visibly entering, exiting, or translating across the scene. Cloud shapes remain largely similar, and no obvious sway of the trees or plants is visible across the whole scene.
relations: Gentle lake ripples cause shifting light and dark wave patterns across the water surface.
Surface ripples briefly disturb the reflected treeline along the forested shoreline.
The dock, bench, foreground shrub, evergreen trees, mountains, and teal lens-flare disc remain fixed.
The camera stays stationary with no objects entering, exiting, or translating across the scene.
